boss.tip: Be respectful and brief. Use "Hello" or "Dear" with their name, and say thank you.

coworker.tip: Friendly is fine. "Hi" plus their first name works. Still skip slang.

customer.tip: Be warm and polite. Use "Dear" or "Hello" with their title and last name, and thank them.

stranger.tip: Be polite and formal. Use "Dear" with their title and last name, or "Dear Hiring Manager" if you don't know it.

teacher.tip: Use their title: Professor, Dr., Mr., or Ms. Name your class. Thank them for their time.
